set.body:
Stage 1 of the post-closeout NumPy performance plan.

Build a reproducible JVM-versus-NumPy matrix before further optimization. Cover the currently unmeasured public surface: subtract/multiply/divide, scalar kernels, min/max, clip, comparisons and predicates, casts, product/min/max/arg/mean/widened reductions, and in-place mutation across Double/Float/Int/Long where supported. Exercise contiguous, transposed, reversed, inner/outer-strided, and broadcast layouts at representative sizes.

Add adversarial non-dyadic inputs and bitwise receipts for the fixed 128-value pairwise reduction contract; exact-binary-fraction fixtures alone are insufficient to detect reassociation. Record allocation, JIT/assembly or equivalent structural evidence where it distinguishes boxing, dispatch, auto-vectorization, and memory bandwidth.

Done means the matrix is parity-gated, reproducible on the supported JDK baseline plus JDK 25, records machine/runtime metadata, retains the existing closeout cases for continuity, and identifies measured targets instead of extrapolating from float64 add/sum alone.
set.title: Expand the NumPy performance matrix and structural gates
